status: PASS: atomic bootstrap, rollback/commit/session matrix, real ten-way races and five rotated A/B/C; separate hash/writer timings retained; normal per-request HTTP p95 within approved +10 ms and no repeated CPU/RSS regression.
source_overlay_note: Explicit snapshots override generic raw source labels; B is archived main.
release_note: Persistent marker is backfilled at startup for existing users without changing them. Marker and admin commit atomically. Old binaries ignore the marker; rollback must close public register. A previously emptied legacy DB with no marker has no evidence distinguishing it from a fresh install.
timing_note: Supplement v2 instrumented first successful write through successful commit, separate real Argon hash timings. It reruns frozen before/after sources; the original pre-change v1 race baseline is retained, not replaced by an estimate. Writer duration includes scheduling/commit and is not a pure SQLite native mutex measurement. One success versus ten means these distributions are not a throughput comparison.
